search_text: published ZDI-23-1560 ZDI-CAN-21375 SolarWinds Access Rights Manager IFormTemplate Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2023-10-19 CVE-2023-35180 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-35180 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['SolarWinds'] ['Access Rights Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Access Rights Manager. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the deserialization of JSON data sent to the API via TCP port 443. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. SolarWinds has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: SolarWinds Access Rights Manager IFormTemplate Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Access Rights Manager. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the deserialization of JSON data sent to the API via TCP port 443. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
